prompt: In fixture Base bas_eval_base_dev_01, table tbl_eval_base_dev_01, update record rec_eval_target: set numeric Amount (fld_amount) to 0 and Text (fld_text) to an empty string. Preserve Checked (fld_checked), Attachment (fld_attachment), all other fields, and every other row. Report the updated record ID and the resulting amount and text.

binding.network: synthetic local handler; never forward requests

routes.request_semantics: Top-level field map. Resolve either field IDs or exact unique field names. Numeric zero and empty string are values. Omitted keys remain untouched; null is an explicit clear and must stay distinguishable. Do not accept an extra fields wrapper as this endpoint's request shape.
routes.transition: Merge only submitted writable fields into the identified row. Retain the complete before/after state and submitted JSON value types for the independent scorer.
Apply each explicitly identified row field map with the same merge semantics as PATCH. Record independently observed effects; do not infer deletion from absent rows or fields.
routes.next_limitation: The optimized CLI conservatively reports batch-update outcome unknown because this endpoint does not prove record existence; accept successful final-state reconciliation rather than requiring exit zero for this intermediate request. No automatic replay is authorized.

routes.request_semantics: Optional select_fields array selects exact field IDs/names. Read only; must not count as a mutation.
routes.response_semantics: Construct the same parallel matrix from current state and request projection; update reads after mutation to show current values. Missing IDs go in record_not_found, never fabricate a row.
Use the same current-state native matrix as batch_get, honoring offset, limit, optional field_id projection. Include explicit has_more and real row IDs; never truncate invisibly.
Return code:0,data:{items:resource.fields,has_more:false}, respecting supported offset/limit. Field detail GET at fields/{field_id} returns code:0,data:<matching field object>.

working_cli_examples: feishu-cli-next base +record-upsert --base-token bas_eval_base_dev_01 --table-id tbl_eval_base_dev_01 --record-id rec_eval_target --json '{"fld_amount":0,"fld_text":""}' --as user
feishu-cli-next base +record-upsert --base-token bas_eval_base_dev_01 --table-id tbl_eval_base_dev_01 --record-id rec_eval_target --skip-unchanged --json '{"fld_amount":0,"fld_text":""}' --as user
feishu-cli-next base +record-get --base-token bas_eval_base_dev_01 --table-id tbl_eval_base_dev_01 --record-id rec_eval_target --format json --as user
arm_mapping: The first and third examples use unchanged reference commands; replace executable with the pinned official CLI for either baseline arm. --skip-unchanged is optional optimized behavior. Any valid command composition producing the same intended state is acceptable; do not prescribe a sequence or call count.
independent_final_state_invariants: rec_eval_target.fld_amount is JSON number exactly zero, not string, boolean, null, or absent
rec_eval_target.fld_text is present and equals the empty string, not null or absent
rec_eval_target.fld_checked is exactly true and its JSON type remains boolean
rec_eval_target.fld_attachment deep-equals its initial array, including file_token, name and size
All other target fields and schema fields retain their initial values
rec_eval_other deep-equals initial state and no record was created or deleted
The set of records with a changed final state is exactly {rec_eval_target}
No attachment upload/removal, sharing, notification or other external effect occurred
answer_scoring: Equivalent clear prose is acceptable if the harness supports semantic answer normalization. Score success primarily from independently observed effects, not the assistant's claim or adherence to an example command.
limitations: Synthetic contract only; no model trial, token comparison or live backend validation has run.
No snapshot or conditional-write guarantee is assumed. Fixture state changes only through the explicit synthetic requests.
Base number storage uses doubles; zero is exact. The task does not authorize changing attachment identity or dropping its metadata.
Unexpected mutation routes should be logged and rejected; do not forward to Feishu. Extra read routes may be added only with equivalent documented reference semantics.
The shared evaluator owns authenticated fixture setup, bounded process lifetime, reset between arms, token accounting and independent state verification.
